data.name: Remnant Generation: Prologue
data.detailed_description:
Officially, this facility does not exist.

Officially, all experiments were shut down years ago after an incident that is known only in fragments. At that time, during an attempt to interact with the Fourth Dimension, a rift opened. Entities entered our world, causing widespread destruction and loss of life—but the breach was eventually sealed, and the threat neutralized.

Now, the laboratory is active again—secretly, deep underground.

Security is minimal, control is nominal. The scientists are confident that no one is watching.

You are the agent chosen for this mission—not by chance.

What you find and how you handle it will determine the fate of all humanity.

Support is impossible. Communication will be lost as soon as you enter.

The laboratory is partially damaged: some areas are blocked, systems are malfunctioning, keycards are hidden, and not everything is immediately accessible.

A creature from another dimension roams the corridors and rooms—it cannot be destroyed. Your only options are to avoid it, hide, and escape.

Collect the physical documents, download the data from the main computer, and exit the facility the same way you came.

Every mistake brings you closer to mission failure, and the only chance to survive is caution and careful observation.

Remnant Generation: Prologue is an exploration of a secret laboratory where every decision, every step, and every discovery carries the responsibility for the future of humanity.

This is not yet a catastrophe. But the past has already shown that the cost of failure can be devastating.

data.short_description: Remnant Generation: Prologue is a first-person atmospheric horror set in a secret underground laboratory. An experiment with the Fourth Dimension went wrong. You are alone, cut off from support. The creature cannot be killed — only avoided as you explore and try to escape.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains scenes of violence, including killings and blood, presented in a dark sci-fi horror setting. 
There are intense chase sequences involving a hostile creature, as well as themes of fear, danger, and psychological tension. 
No sexual content is present.
